in_marathi.name: Vinodbhai
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Giver of Joy, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vinodbhai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vinodbhai is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Vinod' which means 'giver of joy' and 'Bhai' which means 'brother'. This name is believed to bring prosperity and happiness to the one who bears it.
